description:
This file defines a complete Vue 3 component (`Chat.vue`) that serves as the primary interface for managing real-time chat interactions and user outputs.
The UI dynamically shifts between standard browsing, full-screen editing, side-pane previews, and PR review modes based on reactive state flags like `isPRView`.
It follows the specified structure by placing all imports within `<script setup>` while utilizing Options API (`data`, `computed`, `methods`) for complex client-side logic.
System-wide communications are routed efficiently through a centralized `$storex` store and an external `API` service, which handles image uploads, file sharing, and messaging workflows.
All styling is handled via Tailwind CSS utility classes embedded directly into the HTML template tags.

messages.content:
The provided file is a comprehensive **Vue 3 Component** defined with `<script setup>`, `<template>`, and the Options API `<script>` block. It represents the main user interface for an interactive chat application within the `codx-junior` project environment (vue components). 

This component orchestrates the communication logic, file handling, intelligent suggestions engine, and view switching (standard mode vs PR review mode) across a modern web platform using Vue reactivity patterns and Tailwind CSS.

### File Structure
```js /chat/Chat.vue
<template>...</template>
<script setup></script>
<script type="options">...</script>
```

---

### 1. Props (Component Context)
The component consumes specific arguments that dictate its behavior:
- `chat`: The central data object containing message history and status (drives most logic).  
- `readOnly, input-only`: Mode controls preventing user interaction during editing or archival.  
- `filter`: Text filter applied to active messages in the list.  

### 2. Template Logic & View Architecture
The template is an adaptive layout that shifts based on the chat mode:

| Layout Mode | Visibility Condition | Key Elements |
|-------------|----------------------|--------------|
| **Standard Chat** | `!isPRView` | Top bar with file/checklists, message list input, AI model selector, side panel image/file previews. |
| **PR Review**  | `isPRView === true` | Dedicated `ChangesPanel` view replacing the chat message area, tracking diffs & comments. |

The UI is built using Tailwind CSS utilities (e.g., `shrink-0`, `flex-col`, `min-h-full`, `w-1/2`). The main section switches between normal editing and a full-screen editor when `editMessage` state is active.

---

### 3. Data & Reactive State
The component maintains local reactive data within the constructor:  
- **Message Editor:** (`editMessage`, `editorText`) holds content being authored or customized for existing messages.
- **Files & Media:** (`files`, `images`, `imagePreview`, `draftImageUrl`) manage attachments, media uploads, and inline previews without requiring multiple external requests. 
- **IntelliSense Engine:** (`intelliSenseSuggestions`, `intelliSenseDebounce`) buffers search suggestions for @mentions or markdown links, with a 220ms debounce to prevent API bloat.
- **Interaction Flags:** (`isVoiceSession`, `draggingOver`) enables drag-drop content delivery and real-time audio transcription.

### 4. Computed Properties (Derived State)
To optimize DOM updates, many values are pre-calculated:
- `chatFiles()`: Exposes the raw array of files currently attached to this chat.  
- `isPRView() / isVibe() / isTopic()`: Switch logic that determines whether UI elements trigger or render.
- `visibleMessages()`: Filters out hidden posts unless the user explicitly sets `showHidden` prop.
- `canPost()`: Ensures users either have typed text (`editorText`) or attached media (images/file list).

---

### 5. Methods & Core Actions

| Method Category | Functionality |
|-----------------|---------------|
| **Message Sync** | `_syncStableMessages`, manages real-time update of the text editor when live messages arrive from `$storex.api`. Uses efficient deep merge for updates. |
| **IntelliSense Logic** | `scheduleIntelliSense`: Implements keyboard event capture (`Tab` to confirm, `ArrowUp/Down` to select). Triggers via both text changes and cursor movement. |
| **File Handling** | Handles complex workflows: project file extraction, duplicate-forging checks across chat files vs local attachments, and notebook syncing/export actions using `$storex`. |
| **Text Input & Paste** | `onContentPaste`: Detects image URLs via `chatSvc.parseImageFromPaste`, converts HTML to media links, or intercepts project paths for direct file upload. |
| **PR Workflow** | `onPRChange`, manages branch diffs and saves changes back into the project graph, specifically tied to `$chats.saveChatInfo`. |

---

### 6. Integration Points & Dependencies
- **$storex:** Accesses global Vuex/Pinia state (`chat` messages, active projects).  
- **API Service (`API`):** Manages file uploads for images/code and network-level chat action dispatches.  
- **Modules (Vue Imports):** Integrates reusable components like `ChangePanel`, `ImagePreviewModal`, and `FileSelectorModal`. 

### 7. Constraints
The script block excludes Tailwind imports: classes are hardcoded directly within the template (e.g., `<div class="w-full h-full flex gap-2">`) as specified, maintaining clean separation of concerns while preserving full design fidelity.
